title: Winrate Tracker
description:
Winrate Tracker reads the run history the game already writes and tells you how often you actually win.

Adds a Win Rates tile to the Compendium, beside Statistics and Run History.

- Home: your last fifty runs as the headline, a trend chart behind it, and your last ten runs one by one — hover any of them for the whole run.
- Recent form for every character side by side. Press one to narrow the whole screen to it.
- Splits by month, by patch, and in fifty-run blocks, any of which will graph.
- Per-card and per-relic win rates, ranked by how the runs that took them went.
- Every win rate is drawn against your own average, so a number is a comparison rather than a figure on its own.
- Time of day splits (I'm better in the evening, which is odd!)
- One filter row: ascension, character, time window, plus a minimum and a rarity on the pick tabs. Opens on the highest ascension you have played.
- Can optionally exclude floor 1 abandons.
- Full gamepad support.

Nothing needs enabling first, and runs from before you installed it are included.

Project source on Github here:  https://github.com/davekalina/spire2-winrate-tracker

Winrate Tracker currently works with version 0.111.0 on the beta-branch only.
changeNote:
A visual refresh of the whole screen.

- Overview is now Home: last-fifty win rate as the headline, a trend chart, your last ten runs as hoverable pips, and every character's recent form side by side. Press a character to narrow the screen to them.
- The filter row is combo boxes instead of arrow pairs. Everything fits one row, including the card and relic filters, and each filter is a single stop on a gamepad.
- Tables have a new head, alternating rows, rarity and character icons, and a bar showing each row against your own average.
- The screen now opens on the highest ascension you have played rather than always A10.
- Dropped the 10-run block table, which the Home trend now covers, and the losses-by-act and top-deaths tables.
